intro: One cup of grapes is roughly 100 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from natural fruit sugar.
diet: Yes, grapes are a sweet snack that's better than sweets or kuih. But they're small, so it's easy to eat a lot without noticing. Put one cup in a bowl instead of eating straight from the pack. Raisins are calorie-dense, so just take a little.
tips: Put 1 cup in a small bowl before you start eating.
Freeze grapes for a cold snack you eat slowly.
Pair with unsweetened yogurt or a few nuts for protein.

swap.name: 1 cup fresh grapes instead of 1/4 cup raisins
swap.why: About the same calories but much more volume, so you feel fuller.

faq.q: Green or red grapes, which is better?
faq.a: Both are good. Red and black grapes have slightly more antioxidants, but the difference is small.

faq.q: What should I wash grapes with?
faq.a: Soak and rinse with clean water a few times before eating.

faq.q: Are grapes safe for young kids?
faq.a: Safe, but cut them into halves or quarters for small kids so they don't choke.
